data: What is the approximate WER value for CTCC at a beam width of 1024 in the TH-CS model?

The question asks for the approximate WER value for CTCC at a beam width of 1024 in the TH-CS model. From the caption, we know that the figure compares the performance of CTC and CTCC using different sizes of beam for LM rescoring. The relevant graph is the one on the right side of the compound figure, which shows the performance of CTC and CTCC for the TH-CS model. 

Looking at the graph, the blue line represents CTCC, and the orange line represents CTC. At a beam width of 1024, the blue line (CTCC) is below the orange line (CTC), indicating that CTCC performs better than CTC at this beam width. The approximate WER value for CTCC at a beam width of 1024 can be estimated by looking at the y-axis, which represents WER(%) and ranges from approximately 23.6% to 24.4%. 

By visually inspecting the graph, the approximate WER value for CTCC at a beam width of 1024 appears to be around 23.8%.
